dense_architecture.label: dense_v3_baseline
dense_architecture.description: Dense N×N=128×128 coupling matrix with Gibbs sigmoid (v3). All 128 spins couple to all 128 neighbours; sigmoid LUT retained.

sparse_architecture.label: sparse_k16_emvl_v4
sparse_architecture.description: Sparse K=16 E-MVL v4: each of 128 spins couples to 16 neighbours. Gibbs sigmoid replaced by sign()-bit extraction (zero LUT cost). Synchronous double-buffered update.

methodology_note: All LUT estimates use analytic constants from ising_sampler_v4_spec.md: 14 LUTs/mult-add (coupling), 25 LUTs/EMA-mult, 4000 LUTs (control/AXI). No Vivado synthesis run; numbers are pre-synthesis accounting only.
honest_verdict: complete: sparse K=16 E-MVL v4 estimated at 35,872 LUTs (30.6% of 117,120 budget); within_budget=True
